title: Texas town and Randy Brooks as a Bunk pupil
summary: Bunk said he would make Blumberg another Randy Brooks; they discuss Bunk's other pupils.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Learning your horn: teachers, lessons and fees

blocks.x: I can't remember that offhand. I can't remember that offhand. The only other place he talked about that I can recall was the little town on the Texas border that he spent some time in. Yeah. And I remember him talking about that. But one thing I should mention before I forget, and that is talking about the lessons, that at one point there he was saying that he would make me another Randy Brooks.

And, of course, at the time, the name Randy Brooks didn't mean anything to me. I mean, I'd heard the name, but I wasn't acquainted with the playing. And, but Bunk was saying that Randy Brooks was one of his best pupils, and I've always... Actually, he didn't teach him, actually. Yeah, he said he taught Randy, and I've always been curious to find out. Yeah, I don't know anything about him, either.

I never met him or heard him, but if I remember rightly, some record company had given him a contract about that time or a year or two before, maybe, and we're going to build him up to be another, say, band of the Tommy Darcy type or something like that. That's faintly in my mind. I'm not sure. I'd have to, we'll have to look that up now.
Did he ever talk about any of his other pupils that he... Yeah. Either later old ones that he talked to you about?
But I don't remember hearing anything different about that than what I heard on the Monk Talking records, those three sides that came in.
People like Tommy Ladner and, of course, Louie and different people.
